name: Zoviz
summary: AI logo maker and brand platform: design a logo and brand kit for free, then download it with a subscription that adds 5,000+ on-brand templates, AI marketing content, link-in-bio pages, digital business cards and a website builder.
best_for: small businesses, solo founders and agencies that want a logo, a matching brand kit and on-brand social posts, bio pages and a simple website from one tool, and want to try the design before paying
skip_if: you want to buy a logo once and own it without a subscription; you need to know in advance what each AI task costs; or you already have a brand and a designer and only want a template editor
honest_knock:
Zoviz lets you design for free and charges when you download, and downloading also ends your refund: the FAQ allows a refund within 30 days only if no files were downloaded and no AI credits used. There is no one-off logo price on the pricing page; the FAQ's own advice for a logo is a month's subscription, €29 on Starter. The AI credits that drive the marketing tools are not priced per task on the page, expire every billing cycle and are topped up with separately sold packs. Prices change with your location: euros from the Netherlands, a $399 first-year figure for Pro in the page's own US-dollar table. The '4.9/5 from 12,000+ reviews' claim names no source. We have not used Zoviz ourselves.

Zoviz's own pages give two refund rules. The pricing FAQ allows a request within 30 days of purchase if nothing was downloaded and no AI credits were used; the help centre's billing page says that if nothing was used there is no time limit. Both agree that downloading a file counts as use. Ask from your account email with the invoice ID, as the help centre instructs.

Cancelling costs more than the plan. When access ends, unused plan credits are forfeited, published Link in Bio pages and digital business cards go offline, the brands your plan unlocked lock again, and designs saved in the cloud lock; the cancel screen says they are deleted after 90 days. Files you downloaded while subscribed keep their commercial-use rights. A failed renewal ends the plan straight away, with the same effects, and a new card can take up to 2 business days to go through.

Starter includes the website builder, but the help centre says publishing a website needs Pro or Business. The terms place disputes under US law, with the courts and arbitration centre of New York.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-06 on zoviz.com/pricing from a Netherlands connection; the page says prices are shown in EUR based on your location) Three plans, monthly or yearly, with yearly marked -43%. Starter is €29 a month or €199 a year, for 1 brand, 10GB storage, 300 AI credits a month, 1 link-in-bio page, 1 digital business card, the website builder and 1 team member with email support. Pro is €49 a month or €339 a year, for up to 5 brands, 500GB, 800 credits, 5 link-in-bio pages and cards, 1 website with a custom domain, 3 team members and priority support. Business is €99 a month or €679 a year, for up to 15 brands, 2TB, 2,000 credits, unlimited bio pages and cards, up to 5 websites with custom domains and up to 50 team members. Enterprise is on request. Every plan includes the 5,000+ templates, the logo tools, background removal and upscaling, the AI editor and text-to-image. The FAQ says you can design and preview for free and pay only to download; credits reset each billing cycle and do not roll over, extra credit packs can be bought, and each task uses a different number of credits that the page does not list. The page's own savings table prices the Pro plan's first year at $399 in US dollars. Re-read on 28 October 2026 with a plain fetch from a Netherlands connection: the pricing page still opens with 'Starting at €29 per month' and shows yearly savings of €149, €249 and €509, which match the Starter €199, Pro €339 and Business €679 yearly prices read on 6 October (the plan amounts themselves load by script). The help centre's plans page (last updated 15 October 2026) says plans start at $29 a month in the US and does not list other prices. Two numbers differ between Zoviz's own pages: the pricing page gives Business up to 50 team members, the help centre's plan table and team page up to 10. One-off purchases are gone except the Elite Logo Kit, which transfers ownership of the logo icon to you; its price is not on the pages we read. Enterprise credit packages are sold on the Microsoft Azure Marketplace from $4,000 a year.

compare_with.name: Pippit
compare_with.why: Pippit is in our dossiers too, and it overlaps on the marketing side: AI-generated social posts, product videos and ads for small brands. Read on 19 September 2026 from the same Netherlands connection, Pippit had a free plan with daily credits and Starter at €8 a month or €87 a year. Zoviz has no free plan to download from (designing is free, downloading is not) and starts at €29 a month or €199 a year. What the higher price buys is the brand side Pippit does not lead with: the logo maker, a brand kit applied across 5,000+ templates, link-in-bio pages, digital business cards and a website builder. If you already have a logo and want cheap marketing content, Pippit is the cheaper start; if you are building the brand itself, Zoviz is the tool aimed at that.
